profile.headline: Sr. Full Stack Engineer at Latcha+Associates
profile.summary:
I'm an energetic and adaptable software engineer with over 8 years of industry experience. I take a responsible and solutions-oriented approach to every task, and thrive in collaborative environments where precision, performance, and creativity matter.

I’m passionate about continuous learning, with current interests in Go programming language. Outside of work, I enjoy photography and visual design, bringing a creative edge to my technical work.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Integrated real-time telemetry from VW's Car-Net into the Marketing IQ (MIQ) platform to enable live customer messaging and operational insights—enhancing engagement and reducing response time at scale.

Optimized campaign delivery pipelines by upgrading backend infrastructure (Node.js, Angular) and implementing high-efficiency SQL pooling and file compression. This enabled seamless, zero-downtime support for over 4 million customers across thousands of dealerships.

Redesigned APIs and front-end interfaces for MIQ, improving UX and manager workflows. My enhancements, driven by direct user feedback, streamlined day-to-day operations and significantly boosted system usability.

Championed a culture of clean code and agile delivery, continuously improving both the product and team velocity through thoughtful refactoring, mentorship, and cross-functional collaboration.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Engineered a cross-platform Flutter app for care centers, replacing an Angular PWA/WebRTC prototype and drastically reducing check-in/out time through real-time video processing and intuitive UI design.

Developed the dataX Platform, a robust suite for enterprise AI and machine learning, featuring a dynamic Angular UI for bulk image processing and real-time classification visualization—enabling sub-second model feedback at scale.

Led the creation of dataX Sync, a GS1 certification tool, incorporating full-stack validation, Stripe payments integration.

Built a distributed product catalog backend using Node.js/Express.js, Redis, and MongoDB, supporting analytics over 10M+ SKUs with seamless concurrent queries and zero downtime.

Spearheaded a company-wide migration to GitLab CE, standardizing Git workflows, improving CI/CD reliability, and enhancing developer productivity through infrastructure modernization.
